items.titleZh: 认证或网络异常
items.detailsEn: `We were unable to authenticate the app user.`
items.detailsZh: 调用 Meta Graph API 时发生网络中断、DNS 解析失败或未授权请求。
items.solutionEn: Typically this means the included access token has expired, been invalidated, or the app user has changed a setting to prevent all apps from accessing their data. [Get a new access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/access-tokens#system-user-access-tokens).
items.solutionZh: 检查网络连接，核对 Access Token 授权头与 API Version 是否正确。

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 错误码 1
items.detailsEn: Invalid request or possible server error.
items.detailsZh: Invalid request or possible server error.
items.solutionEn: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information. If there are no server outages, check the endpoint reference and verify that your request is formatted correctly and meets all endpoint requirements.
items.solutionZh: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information. If there are no server outages, check the endpoint reference and verify that your request is formatted correctly and meets all endpoint requirements.

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误

items.detailsEn: Temporary due to downtime or due to being overloaded.
items.detailsZh: Temporary due to downtime or due to being overloaded.
items.solutionEn: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information before trying again.
items.solutionZh: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information before trying again.

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 错误码 3
items.detailsEn: Capability or permissions issue.
items.detailsZh: Capability or permissions issue.
items.solutionEn: Use the [access token debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken) to verify that your app has been granted the permissions required by the endpoint. See [Authentication and Authorization Errors](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support#authentication-authorization).
items.solutionZh: Use the [access token debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken) to verify that your app has been granted the permissions required by the endpoint. See [Authentication and Authorization Errors](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support#authentication-authorization).

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 错误码 4
items.detailsEn: The app has reached its API call rate limit.
items.detailsZh: The app has reached its API call rate limit.
items.solutionEn: Load the app in the [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps) and view the **Application Rate Limit** section to verify that the app has reached its [rate limit](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/overview/rate-limiting#wa-biz-api). If it has, try again later or reduce the frequency or amount of API queries the app is making.
items.solutionZh: Load the app in the [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps) and view the **Application Rate Limit** section to verify that the app has reached its [rate limit](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/overview/rate-limiting#wa-biz-api). If it has, try again later or reduce the frequency or amount of API queries the app is making.

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 错误码 10
items.detailsEn: Permission is either not granted or has been removed.
items.detailsZh: Permission is either not granted or has been removed.
items.solutionEn: Use the [access token debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken) to verify that your app has been granted the permissions required by the endpoint.<br><br>See [Authentication and Authorization Errors](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support#authentication-authorization).<br><br>For WhatsApp Flows with Endpoint - ensure that the phone number used to [set your business public key](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/flows/cloud-api/reference/whatsapp-business-encryption#set-business-public-key) is allowlisted.<br><br>Check the eligibility requirements for the API that you are trying to access. If you are not eligible to access the endpoints, you will receive this error code.
items.solutionZh: Use the [access token debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken) to verify that your app has been granted the permissions required by the endpoint.<br><br>See [Authentication and Authorization Errors](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support#authentication-authorization).<br><br>For WhatsApp Flows with Endpoint - ensure that the phone number used to [set your business public key](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/flows/cloud-api/reference/whatsapp-business-encryption#set-business-public-key) is allowlisted.<br><br>Check the eligibility requirements for the API that you are trying to access. If you are not eligible to access the endpoints, you will receive this error code.

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 错误码 33
items.detailsEn: The business phone number has been deleted.
items.detailsZh: The business phone number has been deleted.
items.solutionEn: Verify that the business phone number is correct.
items.solutionZh: Verify that the business phone number is correct.

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: 请求参数无效或缺失
items.detailsEn: `(#100) Invalid parameter`
items.detailsZh: 请求体 JSON 或 URL 查询参数格式错误，缺少必填字段或传入了不支持的数据类型。
items.solutionEn: `Message must be a template message.`
items.solutionZh: 检查 API 请求体格式，核对 JSON 语法与必填字段。若上传媒体，确认 Content-Type 为 multipart/form-data。

items.titleZh: API 请求签名校验失败
items.detailsEn: Incorrect signature
items.detailsZh: 调用号码管理或资产配置接口时提供的 appsecret_proof 或请求签名校验不匹配。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (phone_numbers/).
items.solutionZh: 检查用于生成签名的 App Secret 与当前使用的 Access Token 是否匹配，确保 HMAC-SHA256 算法计算正确。

items.titleZh: 访问令牌已过期或失效
items.detailsEn: Your access token has expired.
items.detailsZh: 当前使用的 System User 或 User Access Token 已过期、被重置或已被撤销权限。
items.solutionEn: Get a new [access token](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/access-tokens).
items.solutionZh: 在 Meta 商务管理平台重新生成永久系统用户访问令牌（Permanent System User Token），或使用 Token Debugger 验证令牌有效性。

items.titleEn: Invalid Phone Number in Template Request
items.titleZh: 创建模板关联号码无效
items.detailsEn: Invalid phone number
items.detailsZh: 创建或关联消息模板时所指定的发送方号码格式不正确，或该号码未在当前 WABA 商业账号下激活。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (message_templates/).
items.solutionZh: 检查请求中提供的商业电话号码 ID 与格式（必须为国际 E.164 格式，不含 + 号和空格），确认该号码在 Meta 控制台状态为 CONNECTED。

items.titleZh: 应用权限不足
items.detailsEn: No access token was provided. The API returns the message "Provide valid app ID". This error occurs on certain GET endpoints (such as `whatsapp_business_profile`) when no token is included. Other endpoints may return error code 190 or 104 instead.
items.detailsZh: 调用该接口所需权限未授予给当前 Access Token（例如缺少 whatsapp_business_messaging 或 whatsapp_business_management 权限）。
items.solutionEn: Ensure your request includes a valid access token. This is distinct from error code 190 (expired or invalid token). See [Access Tokens](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/access-tokens).
items.solutionZh: 在 Meta App Dashboard 中检查 App 权限配置，确保系统用户分配了对应 WhatsApp Business 资产的完全管理权限。

items.titleZh: 号码或资产属性编辑失败
items.detailsEn: Edit failure
items.detailsZh: 尝试更新商业电话号码的展示名称、PIN 码或配置属性时发生底层更新失败。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (phone_numbers/).
items.solutionZh: 确认当前号码处于正常可用状态且未在进行双重认证审核流程；若修改展示名称请先确保已通过企业商业认证。

items.titleZh: 账号因违反 Meta 政策被临时封禁
items.detailsEn: `The WhatsApp Business Account associated with the app has been restricted or disabled for violating a platform policy.`
items.detailsZh: 由于发送内容被用户大量举报、违反 WhatsApp 商业通讯准则或触发反垃圾风控，账号已被临时限制发信。
items.solutionEn: See the [Policy Enforcement](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/policy-enforcement) document to learn about policy violations and how to resolve them.
items.solutionZh: 停止批量推送营销内容，登录 WhatsApp Manager 查看违规警告，并在 Meta 商务管理平台“账户品质”页面提交申诉。

items.categoryNameZh: 常规 Graph API 错误
items.titleZh: Graph API 查询语句语法解析失败
items.detailsEn: Error parsing graph query
items.detailsZh: URL 中的 fields、filtering 或 pagination 参数格式不正确，包含未转义字符或不支持的查询语法。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (root).
items.solutionZh: 检查 GET 请求中的 query string 格式，确保逗号分隔字段名无多余空格，且过滤参数符合 Meta Graph API 规范。

items.titleZh: 调用频率超出应用限额
items.detailsEn: `The WhatsApp Business Account has reached its rate limit.`
items.detailsZh: Meta 开发者应用级的全局调用次数超出设定的限制。
items.solutionEn: See WhatsApp Business account [Rate Limits](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/about-the-platform#rate-limits). Try again later or reduce the frequency or amount of API queries the app is making.
items.solutionZh: 暂停非核心请求，优化请求批处理，降低查询频次。

items.titleZh: 商业账号级调用频次超限
items.detailsEn: There have been too many calls to this WhatsApp Business account. Wait a bit and try again. For more info, please refer to https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/overview/rate-limiting.
items.detailsZh: 短时间内向该 WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) 发起的 Graph API 请求总数超过 Meta 设定的并发安全阈值。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (root).
items.solutionZh: 降低 API 轮询或批量调用频次，加入指数退避重试（Exponential Backoff）机制，参考 Meta 限频响应头 X-Business-Use-Case-Usage。

items.detailsEn: Unable to deliver the message. This business has blocked the end user on WhatsApp
items.detailsZh: Unable to deliver the message. This business has blocked the end user on WhatsApp
items.solutionEn: Do not retry. Unblock the WhatsApp user to resume sending messages to them. See [Unblock a user](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/block-users/#unblock-a-user).
items.solutionZh: Do not retry. Unblock the WhatsApp user to resume sending messages to them. See [Unblock a user](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/block-users/#unblock-a-user).

items.titleZh: 达到 API 速率限流或吞吐量上限 (Rate Limit Hit)
items.detailsEn: Cloud API message throughput has been reached.
items.detailsZh: 向特定手机号或整个 WABA 账号发送消息的瞬时速率已达到并发限制或限流阈值（如 80 MPS 或 Tier 限制）。
items.solutionEn: The app has reached the API's throughput limit. See [Throughput](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/throughput). Try again later or reduce the frequency with which the app sends messages.
items.solutionZh: 引入队列缓冲（如 Redis / RabbitMQ），降低并发频率进行限流调控，实施指数退避算法（Exponential Backoff）重试，或向 Meta 申请提升 Throughput 吞吐量。

items.detailsEn: Message was not sent as part of an [experiment](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/experiments).
items.detailsZh: Message was not sent as part of an [experiment](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/experiments).
items.solutionEn: See [Marketing Message Experiment](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/experiments#marketing-message-experiment).
items.solutionZh: See [Marketing Message Experiment](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/experiments#marketing-message-experiment).

items.detailsEn: `The WhatsApp Business Account is restricted from messaging to users in certain countries.`
items.detailsZh: `The WhatsApp Business Account is restricted from messaging to users in certain countries.`
items.solutionEn: See [WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy](https://business.whatsapp.com/policy) for details on allowed countries for messaging in your business category.
items.solutionZh: See [WhatsApp Business Messaging Policy](https://business.whatsapp.com/policy) for details on allowed countries for messaging in your business category.

items.titleZh: WhatsApp 服务内部异常
items.detailsEn: Message failed to send due to an unknown error.
items.detailsZh: Meta 内部服务在处理该条消息时发生未知异常或暂时性故障。
items.solutionEn: Try again. If the error persists, open a [Direct Support](https://business.facebook.com/direct-support) ticket.<br><br>For WhatsApp Flows with Endpoint - when [setting a business public key](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/flows/cloud-api/reference/whatsapp-business-encryption#set-business-public-key), it either failed to calculate the signature, call the GraphQL endpoint, or the GraphQL endpoint returned an error.
items.solutionZh: 稍后重试该请求；同时关注 metastatus.com 查看 WhatsApp 官方服务是否处于故障维护状态。

items.titleZh: 权限未授予或已被撤销
items.detailsEn: Permission is either not granted or has been removed.
items.detailsZh: Token 未获得调用此接口所需的必要权限，或相关资产（如电话号码）与当前 WABA 解除了绑定。
items.solutionEn: Use the [access token debugger](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/debug/accesstoken) to verify that your app has been granted the permissions required by the endpoint. See [Authentication and authorization errors](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support#authentication-authorization).
items.solutionZh: 在 Meta 开发者后台使用 Access Token Debugger 验证权限并重新授权。

items.titleZh: 缺少必需的请求参数
items.detailsEn: The request is missing a required parameter.
items.detailsZh: 请求中缺少此消息类型必须提供的参数（如 to、type、template、image.id 等）。
items.solutionEn: See the endpoint's reference to determine which parameters are required.
items.solutionZh: 对照官方 API 文档检查请求体，确保传入了 messaging_product: "whatsapp" 以及对应类型的数据对象。

items.titleZh: 参数值不合法
items.detailsEn: `(#131009) Parameter value is not valid`
items.detailsZh: 提供的参数值不符合规格要求（例如手机号未包含国家区号、URL 不符合规范等）。
items.solutionEn: `One or more parameter values are invalid.`
items.solutionZh: 规范化手机号格式（去掉前导加号、空格或破折号，如 8613800000000）。

items.titleZh: 服务暂时不可用
items.detailsEn: A service is temporarily unavailable.
items.detailsZh: WhatsApp 平台正在进行维护或遭遇暂时性过载。
items.solutionEn: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information before trying again.
items.solutionZh: 在尝试重新发送前，请查阅 metastatus.com 官方状态页。

items.titleEn: Sender and Recipient are the Same
items.titleZh: 发件人与收件人号码相同
items.detailsEn: Sender and recipient phone number is the same.
items.detailsZh: 请求中的接收方手机号与您配置的 WhatsApp Business 发信号码一致。
items.solutionEn: Send a message to a phone number different from the sender.
items.solutionZh: 修改 to 参数为外部测试接收者的真实手机号。

items.titleZh: 消息无法送达 (Message Undeliverable)
items.detailsEn: Unable to deliver message. Reasons can include:<br><br>* The recipient phone number is not a WhatsApp phone number.<br>* Recipient has not accepted the new Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.<br>* Recipient using an old WhatsApp version; must use the following WhatsApp version or greater:<br>  * Android: 2.21.15.15<br>  * SMBA: 2.21.15.15<br>  * iOS: 2.21.170.4<br>  * SMBI: 2.21.170.4<br>  * KaiOS: 2.2130.10<br>  * Web: 2.2132.6
items.detailsZh: 接收方手机号未注册 WhatsApp、对方版本过低、对方拉黑了该商家号码，或尚未同意最新的 WhatsApp 隐私条款。
items.solutionEn: Using a non-WhatsApp communication method, ask the WhatsApp user to:<br><br>* Confirm that they can actually send a message to your WhatsApp Business phone number.<br>* Confirm that they have accepted the latest Terms of Service (**Settings** > **Help**, or **Settings** > **Application information** will prompt them to accept the latest terms/policies if they haven't done so already)<br>* Update to the latest version of the WhatsApp client.
items.solutionZh: 确认接收方手机号确实开通了 WhatsApp；通过其他渠道让用户主动向您的商业号码发送一条消息以解除阻断。

items.detailsEn: `The WhatsApp Business Account associated with the app has been restricted or disabled for violating a platform policy, or we were unable to verify data included in the request against data set on the WhatsApp Business Account (e.g, the two-step pin included in the request is incorrect).`
items.detailsZh: `The WhatsApp Business Account associated with the app has been restricted or disabled for violating a platform policy, or we were unable to verify data included in the request against data set on the WhatsApp Business Account (e.g, the two-step pin included in the request is incorrect).`
items.solutionEn: See the [Policy Enforcement](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/policy-enforcement) document to learn about policy violations and how to resolve them.<br><br>You can also use the [Health Status API](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/health-status), which may provide additional insight into the reason or reasons for the account lock.
items.solutionZh: See the [Policy Enforcement](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/policy-enforcement) document to learn about policy violations and how to resolve them.<br><br>You can also use the [Health Status API](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/support/health-status), which may provide additional insight into the reason or reasons for the account lock.

items.titleEn: Business Phone Number Display Name Not Approved
items.titleZh: 商业号码显示名称未通过审核
items.detailsEn: The [555 business phone number](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/embedded-signup/overview#555-business-phone-numbers) used to send the request does not have an approved [display name](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/display-names).
items.detailsZh: 使用的商业号码 Display Name 处于审核中、被拒绝或尚未设置。
items.solutionEn: Change the 555 business phone number's [display name](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/display-names). Also see our [How to change your WhatsApp Business display name](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/378834799515077) Help Center article.
items.solutionZh: 登录 WhatsApp Manager 前往电话号码设置，重新提交符合命名准则的显示名称等待审核。

items.titleZh: 支付方式异常或账单超限
items.detailsEn: There was an error related to your payment method.
items.detailsZh: 绑定的信用卡扣费失败、信用额度超标、未设置币种/时区，或 WABA 未关联有效的支付账户。
items.solutionEn: See [About Billing For Your WhatsApp Business account](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/2225184664363779) and verify that you have set up billing correctly.<br><br>Common problems:<br><br>- Payment account is not attached to a WhatsApp Business account<br>- Credit line is over the limit<br>- Credit line (Payment Account) not set or active<br>- WhatsApp Business account is deleted<br>- WhatsApp Business account is suspended<br>- Timezone not set<br>- Currency not set<br>- MessagingFor request (On Behalf Of) is pending or declined
items.solutionZh: 进入 Meta 商务管理平台的“账单与支付”页面更新信用卡，并确保 WABA 已正确关联支付账户。

items.titleZh: 手机号码未完成注册
items.detailsEn: Message failed to send due to a phone number registration error.
items.detailsZh: 商业号码尚未通过 2-Step Verification 或官方注册流程激活。
items.solutionEn: [Register the phone number](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration) before trying again.
items.solutionZh: 调用 POST /{PHONE_NUMBER_ID}/register 端点完成注册后再发送消息。

items.titleZh: 24小时客户服务窗口已过期 (Re-engagement Window)
items.detailsEn: More than 24 hours have passed since the recipient last replied to the sender number.
items.detailsZh: 自用户最后一次向您的号码发信已超过 24 小时，此时禁止发送普通自由格式消息（文本、图片等）。
items.solutionEn: Send the recipient a [template message](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview) instead.
items.solutionZh: 必须改用经过 Meta 审核批准的“消息模板 (Template Message)”重新唤醒用户；用户回复后会重新开启 24 小时自由对话窗口。

items.titleZh: 触发防垃圾信息频率限制
items.detailsEn: Message failed to send because there are restrictions on how many messages can be sent from this phone number. This may be because too many previous messages were blocked or flagged as spam.
items.detailsZh: 短时间内向没有互动的用户发送过多营销消息，被系统垃圾过滤器拦截。
items.solutionEn: Check your quality status in the WhatsApp Manager. See [Template limits](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview#template-limits) and [Template quality](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-quality).
items.solutionZh: 暂停向未互动冷用户推送，提高消息相关性，等待限流解除。

items.titleEn: Per-User Marketing Template Message Limit Reached
items.titleZh: 达到单用户营销模板消息推送上限
items.detailsEn: This message was not delivered to maintain healthy ecosystem engagement.
items.detailsZh: 为保护生态体验，Meta 限制了向单个 WhatsApp 用户连续推送营销模板的频次。
items.solutionEn: If you do receive this error code and suspect it is due to the limit, wait at least 24 hours before resending the template message. Doing so will only result in another error response since the limit may be in effect for differing periods of time.<br><br>See [Per-User Marketing Template Message Limits](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/marketing-templates/per-user-limits) for additional information.
items.solutionZh: 请至少等待 24 小时后再向该用户重试发送营销模板，或改用实用通知型（Utility）模板。

items.titleEn: User Opted Out of Marketing Messages
items.titleZh: 用户已退订营销消息
items.detailsEn: Unable to deliver the message. This recipient has chosen to stop receiving marketing messages on WhatsApp from your business.
items.detailsZh: 该用户通过 WhatsApp 客户端内的退订按钮或回复 STOP 退订了来自该商家的营销推送。
items.solutionEn: Do not retry sending messages to this user as they will not be received. To be notified whenever a WhatsApp user stops or resumes delivery of marketing template messages from your business, subscribe to the [user_preferences webhook](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/webhooks/reference/user_preferences).
items.solutionZh: 严禁向该用户重试营销消息。请监听 user_preferences Webhook 同步用户的退订状态。

items.titleZh: 不支持的消息类型
items.detailsEn: Unsupported message type.
items.detailsZh: 请求中指定的 type 字段不被 WhatsApp Cloud API 支持。
items.solutionEn: See [Messages](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/messages/send-messages#message-types) for supported message types before trying again with a supported message type.
items.solutionZh: 参考官方文档仅使用支持的类型：text, image, video, audio, document, sticker, template, interactive, location, contacts 等。

items.titleZh: 用户媒体下载失败
items.detailsEn: Unable to download the media sent by the user.
items.detailsZh: 用户发送的图片或视频无法从 WhatsApp 服务器获取，可能已过期或文件损坏。
items.solutionEn: The media included in the WhatsApp user's message could not be downloaded. For more information, refer to the `error.error_data.details` value in any **messages** webhooks triggered when this message was received.<br><br>Ask the WhatsApp user to send you the media file using a non-WhatsApp method.
items.solutionZh: 从 messages Webhook 中检查 error_data.details，必要时请用户重新发送。

items.titleZh: 媒体文件上传或格式不符
items.detailsEn: Unable to upload the media used in the message.
items.detailsZh: 上传的媒体文件超过大小限制（图片>5MB，视频/音频>16MB，文档>100MB），或者格式/编码不合规。
items.solutionEn: The media could not be uploaded for one or more reasons, such as an unsupported media type.<br><br>For more information, refer to the `error.error_data.details` value in any **messages** webhooks triggered when this message fails to send.<br><br>Inspect any media files that are causing errors and confirm that they are in fact supported. For example, in UNIX you can use file inspection via the command line to determine its MIME type:<br><br>`file -I rejected-file.mov`<br><br>You can then confirm if its MIME type is supported. See [Supported Media Types](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/media#supported-media-types).
items.solutionZh: 使用本工具的“媒体文件工具”进行检测与转码：图片压至 5MB，视频转 H.264/AAC，贴纸转 512x512 WebP。

items.detailsEn: `(#131055) Method not allowed`
items.detailsZh: `(#131055) Method not allowed`
items.solutionEn: `Only marketing template messages are supported`
items.solutionZh: `Only marketing template messages are supported`

items.detailsEn: Too many messages sent from the sender phone number to the same recipient phone number in a short period of time.
items.detailsZh: Too many messages sent from the sender phone number to the same recipient phone number in a short period of time.
items.solutionEn: Wait and retry the operation, if you intend to send messages to the same phone number. You can still send messages to a different phone number without waiting.
items.solutionZh: Wait and retry the operation, if you intend to send messages to the same phone number. You can still send messages to a different phone number without waiting.

items.titleZh: 商业账号处于维护模式
items.detailsEn: Business Account is in maintenance mode
items.detailsZh: 该 WhatsApp 商业账号正由 Meta 升级吞吐量或执行后台维护，临时无法发信。
items.solutionEn: The WhatsApp Business account is in maintenance mode. One reason for this could be that the account is undergoing a [throughput](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/throughput) upgrade.
items.solutionZh: 请稍候片刻重试。

items.titleEn: Marketing Templates Disabled on Cloud API
items.titleZh: 当前配置禁用了 Cloud API 营销模板
items.detailsEn: Your template is categorized as Marketing, but marketing templates are currently disabled for your Cloud API configuration.
items.detailsZh: 商业账号开启了 disable_marketing_messages_on_cloud_api 配置。
items.solutionEn: The business has set `disable_marketing_messages_on_cloud_api` to `true` on their Messaging account. To send this template, use the [Marketing Messages API](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/marketing-messages/send-marketing-messages), or [re-enable marketing templates on Cloud API](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/marketing-messages/send-marketing-messages#re-enable-marketing-messages-on-cloud-api) by setting `disable_marketing_messages_on_cloud_api` to `false`.
items.solutionZh: 在 Messaging 账号设置中将 disable_marketing_messages_on_cloud_api 改为 false。

items.titleZh: 账号处于受限发信等级
items.detailsEn: Message failed to send because this account has reached its messaging limit due to template classification violations. This applies to both template messages and direct send messages.
items.detailsZh: 商业账号当前处于受限发信层级，无法向非测试收件人发起营销或业务通知。
items.solutionEn: Review your template classifications and ensure they are categorized correctly. This restriction is automatically lifted after the enforcement period. See [Template quality](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-quality) for more information.
items.solutionZh: 在 WhatsApp Manager 中查看企业质量评级（Quality Rating），完成商业认证以提升 Messaging Tier 发信额度。

items.titleZh: 模板变量参数个数不匹配
items.detailsEn: The number of variable parameter values included in the request did not match the number of variable parameters defined in the template.
items.detailsZh: 请求中传入的 {{1}}、{{2}} 参数数量与模板在 WhatsApp Manager 中审核通过的变量数不一致。
items.solutionEn: See our [Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview#parameter-formats) document to learn about parameters and make sure the request includes values for all of the parameters required by the template.
items.solutionZh: 核对模板定义的 component（HEADER、BODY、BUTTONS）中的参数个数与顺序，确保每个变量都有对应的值。

items.titleEn: Template Does Not Exist or Not Approved
items.titleZh: 模板不存在或未获批准
items.detailsEn: The template does not exist in the specified language or the template has not been approved.
items.detailsZh: 请求中的模板名称（name）或语言地区代码（language.code 如 zh_CN）不存在，或模板仍处于审查/拒绝状态。
items.solutionEn: Make sure your template has been approved and the template name and language locale are correct. See our [Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview) document to learn more about templates.
items.solutionZh: 进入 WhatsApp Manager 确认模板是否为 APPROVED 状态，且 template name 和 language 字母大小写完全吻合。

items.titleZh: 翻译文本长度超标
items.detailsEn: Translated text is too long.
items.detailsZh: 多语言翻译后的模板文字长度超出了 Meta 设定的字符限制。
items.solutionEn: Check the WhatsApp Manager to verify that your template has been translated. See our [Template quality](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-quality) document to learn how to check the status of your template.
items.solutionZh: 精简模板文字后重新提交审核。

items.titleZh: 模板内容违反商业准则
items.detailsEn: Template content violates a WhatsApp policy.
items.detailsZh: 模板包含虚假促销、违禁商品或敏感营销词汇，未通过政策审查。
items.solutionEn: See our [Template review](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-review) document to learn about possible reasons for the violation.
items.solutionZh: 参阅《WhatsApp 商业政策》调整文案并重新申请审核。

items.titleZh: 模板变量参数格式错误
items.detailsEn: Variable parameter values formatted incorrectly.
items.detailsZh: 模板参数未能符合预设类型（例如期望 Currency/DateTime 或 Header 媒体 Handle，但传入了普通文本）。
items.solutionEn: The variable parameter values included in the request are not using the format specified in the template. See our [Templates](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/overview#parameter-formats) document to learn more about template parameters and formats.
items.solutionZh: 检查 parameters 数组内的 type 属性（text / currency / date_time / image / document / video）。

items.titleEn: Template Paused Due to Low Quality
items.titleZh: 模板因质量评级过低被暂停 (Paused)
items.detailsEn: Template is paused due to [low quality](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-quality) so it cannot be sent in a template message.
items.detailsZh: 用户对该模板点击“拉黑”或“举报”过多，Meta 系统自动暂停了该模板的发送。
items.solutionEn: [Edit the template](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-management#edit-templates) to improve its quality and try again once it is approved.
items.solutionZh: 在 WhatsApp Manager 中修改文案，提高受众契合度并降低打扰性，重新提交审核。

items.titleZh: 模板被永久停用 (Disabled)
items.detailsEn: Template has been paused too many times due to [low quality](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/templates/template-quality) and is now permanently disabled.
items.detailsZh: 模板多次因低质量评级被暂停后仍未改善，已被 Meta 永久禁用。
items.solutionEn: Create a new template with different content.
items.solutionZh: 该模板无法恢复，请新建全新模板并重新审核。

items.detailsEn: `(#132018) Template validation error`
items.detailsZh: `(#132018) Template validation error`
items.solutionEn: `There's an issue with the parameters in your template.`
items.solutionZh: `There's an issue with the parameters in your template.`

items.titleZh: WhatsApp Flow 处于阻断状态
items.detailsEn: Flow is in blocked state.
items.detailsZh: 消息中包含的 WhatsApp Flow 存在配置严重错误被系统阻断。
items.solutionEn: Correct the Flow
items.solutionZh: 在 Flow Builder 中排查端点可用性与 JSON 结构，重新发布 Flow。

items.titleZh: WhatsApp Flow 处于频控限制中
items.detailsEn: Flow is in throttled state and 10 messages using this flow were already sent in the last hour.
items.detailsZh: 该 Flow 在过去 1 小时内已触发限流阈值。
items.solutionEn: Correct the Flow
items.solutionZh: 降低 Flow 触发频次，优化处理性能。

items.titleZh: 商业号码注销失败
items.detailsEn: A previous deregistration attempt failed.
items.detailsZh: 尝试从 WhatsApp Business Platform 解绑该号码时发生内部错误。
items.solutionEn: [Deregister](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration#deregister-phone) the number again before [registering](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration).
items.solutionZh: 稍后重试，或联系 Meta 商业技术支持。

items.titleZh: 号码注册时服务器暂时性错误
items.detailsEn: Server is temporarily unavailable.
items.detailsZh: 在请求两步验证短信/语音或提交 PIN 码时发生网络或服务震荡。
items.solutionEn: Check the [WhatsApp Business Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/whatsapp-business-api) page to see API status information and check the response `details` value before trying again.
items.solutionZh: 等待 5 分钟后再次请求验证码。

items.titleZh: 两步验证 PIN 码不正确
items.detailsEn: Two-step verification PIN incorrect.
items.detailsZh: 在注册端点提交的 6 位数字 PIN 码与之前设置的 PIN 不匹配。
items.solutionEn: Verify that the two-step verification PIN included in the request is correct.<br><br>To reset the PIN, disable two-step verification, then set a new PIN. See [Two-step verification](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/phone-numbers#two-step-verification).
items.solutionZh: 输入正确的 6 位 PIN 码；如遗忘，请在 WhatsApp Manager 申请重置两步验证 PIN 码。

items.titleZh: 手机号码需要重新验证
items.detailsEn: Phone number needs to be verified before registering.
items.detailsZh: 该号码长时间未活跃或发生证书迁移，需要重新完成短信/语音验证。
items.solutionEn: [Verify and register the phone number](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/registering-phone-numbers).
items.solutionZh: 重新调用请求验证码接口完成两步注册。

items.detailsEn: Too many two-step verification PIN guesses for this phone number.
items.detailsZh: Too many two-step verification PIN guesses for this phone number.
items.solutionEn: Try again after the amount of time specified in the `details` response value.
items.solutionZh: Try again after the amount of time specified in the `details` response value.

items.detailsEn: Two-step verification PIN was entered too quickly.
items.detailsZh: Two-step verification PIN was entered too quickly.
items.solutionEn: Check the `details` response value before trying again.
items.solutionZh: Check the `details` response value before trying again.

items.titleZh: 手机号码已注册在其他 WhatsApp 客户端
items.detailsEn: Phone number not registered on the WhatsApp Business Platform.
items.detailsZh: 该手机号码当前仍绑定在普通的 WhatsApp Messenger 或 WhatsApp Business App 手机客户端上。
items.solutionEn: [Register the phone number](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration) before trying again.
items.solutionZh: 必须先在手机客户端的“设置 -> 账号”中点击“删除账号 (Delete Account)”，方可在 Cloud API 中注册。

items.titleZh: 号码证书无效或已过期
items.detailsEn: The phone number you are attempting to register was recently deleted, and deletion has not yet completed.
items.detailsZh: 注册号码时提供的证书 Base64 格式无效或证书签发时间超期。
items.solutionEn: Wait 5 minutes before re-trying the request.
items.solutionZh: 在 WhatsApp Business Manager 重新生成新的证书后再进行注册。

items.titleZh: 号码证书已被吊销
items.detailsEn: `Registration or Deregistration failed because there were too many attempts for this phone number in a short period of time`
items.detailsZh: 证书由于安全或违规原因被 Meta 系统撤销。
items.solutionEn: The business phone number is being blocked because it has reached its registration/deregistration attempt limit. Try again once the number is unblocked. See "Limitations" in the [Registration](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/business-phone-numbers/registration) document.
items.solutionZh: 重新进行商业认证并申请新证书。

items.titleZh: 支付配置或商业账单异常
items.detailsEn: `Message failed to send because WhatsApp Payments terms of service acceptance is pending for this WhatsApp Business Account.`
items.detailsZh: 商业账号未绑定有效信用卡/支付方式，或所绑定的付款账户已欠费停用。
items.solutionEn: Accept the WhatsApp Payments terms of service using the link provided in the error message before trying again.
items.solutionZh: 在 Meta 商务管理平台的“支付方式”页面添加有效付款凭证，结算逾期账单后重试。

items.titleZh: WhatsApp Flow 处于阻断状态
items.detailsEn: `(#134100) Only marketing messages supported`
items.detailsZh: 消息模板引用的 WhatsApp Flow 交互式流程因安全审查不通过或被手动停用而无法加载。
items.solutionEn: `You're only able to send marketing messages on this API.`
items.solutionZh: 在 WhatsApp Manager 中进入 Flows 界面，检查并重新发布 Flow 流程定义。

items.titleZh: WhatsApp Flow 触发频控限制
items.detailsEn: `(#134101) Your template is still syncing`
items.detailsZh: 当前 Flow 数据终端（Data Endpoint）短时间内处理的互动请求超过阈值。
items.solutionEn: `When you send a message from a template, the template syncing process can take up to 10 minutes to complete. Wait a few minutes, and then try sending your message again.`
items.solutionZh: 优化后端 Flow Endpoint 处理延迟与并发吞吐量，实施缓存策略以降低响应时间。

items.titleZh: WhatsApp Flow 终端服务异常
items.detailsEn: `(#134102) Template unavailable for use`
items.detailsZh: Meta 尝试调用开发者的 Flow 数据终端时发生网络超时、证书失效或返回了非 200 HTTP 响应。
items.solutionEn: `Please check your eligibility status to ensure you are onboarded or contact Meta's customer support.`
items.solutionZh: 检查 Flow 数据终端 URL 的公网可达性与 HTTPS 证书，核对解密与加密响应签名逻辑。

items.titleZh: 商业订单处理超时
items.detailsEn: Message failed to send because of an unknown error with your request parameters.
items.detailsZh: WhatsApp 商业支付交易在与支付服务提供商交互时发生超时中断。
items.solutionEn: See the endpoint's [reference](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/overview) to determine if you are querying the endpoint using the correct syntax.  Contact [customer support](https://developers.facebook.com/support/) if you continue receiving this error code in response.
items.solutionZh: 检查关联的支付网关（如 Razorpay、PayU 等）运行状况，使用订单查询接口核对交易状态。

items.titleZh: 内容触发安全与反垃圾合规拦截
items.detailsEn: Blocked by Integrity
items.detailsZh: 提交的消息模板内容、变量占位符或包含的链接被 Meta 自动化反垃圾/安全合规系统（Integrity Engine）判定存在潜在风险或违规。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (message_templates/).
items.solutionZh: 检查模板正文是否包含敏感商业诱导词、短网址（短链接跳转）或钓鱼欺诈嫌疑内容；修改话术并确保链接指向真实官方域名。

items.titleEn: Cannot Add Phone Number to WABA
items.titleZh: 无法将电话号码添加至商业账号
items.detailsEn: Cannot add phone number to WhatsApp Business Account
items.detailsZh: 尝试将新号码绑定至 WABA 时失败，可能因该号码已被其他个人/商业 WhatsApp 账号占用、未完成注销或商业账号电话号码配额已达上限。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (phone_numbers/).
items.solutionZh: 若号码此前在 WhatsApp 手机客户端使用，必须先在客户端执行“删除账号”注销；确认 WABA 所属企业是否已通过企业认证以获取更多号码配额。

items.titleZh: 结构化消息模板创建失败
items.detailsEn: HSM Template creation failed
items.detailsZh: 创建 HSM 消息模板时组件结构定义错误，缺少必需的 BODY 组件或变量占位符序号不连续（如跳过 {{1}} 直接使用 {{2}}）。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (message_templates/).
items.solutionZh: 核对 components 数组结构，必须包含 BODY 类型；变量参数序号必须从 {{1}} 开始严格递增，按钮链接变量仅允许在尾部添加。

items.titleZh: 模板送达与转化分析数据尚未就绪
items.detailsEn: Template Insights are not available yet for this WhatsApp Business account
items.detailsZh: 请求读取该商业账号的模板统计分析（Template Insights）时，该模板发送量不足或 Meta 统计流水线尚未汇总完成。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (root).
items.solutionZh: 模板数据分析通常需要积累一定的发送量（通常至少 100+ 条）并在次日生成报表，请等待 Meta 离线流水线产出数据后再行查询。

items.titleEn: WABA Has No Linked Phone Numbers
items.titleZh: 商业账号未关联任何电话号码
items.detailsEn: WhatsApp Business Account has no linked phone numbers.
items.detailsZh: 调用会话分析、定价报表或发信操作时，当前指定的 WABA 商业账号下没有任何已验证启用的电话号码。
items.solutionEn: Refer to WhatsApp Graph API Reference (root).
items.solutionZh: 进入 Meta 商务管理平台 WhatsApp Manager，在 Phone Numbers 菜单下添加并验证至少一个企业电话号码，待状态为 Connected 后再重试。

items.titleZh: 商品目录中未找到对应商品
items.detailsEn: `(#1752041) Duplicate Request`
items.detailsZh: 交互式产品消息（Single/Multi-Product Message）中指定的 retailer_id 在关联的商品目录中不存在或已下架。
items.solutionEn: `Duplicate Request is thrown when a client has already been invited to onboard by any partner.`
items.solutionZh: 在 Meta Commerce Manager 中确认商品目录已与 WABA 成功绑定，检查 retailer_id 是否有效且商品处于审核通过（Approved）状态。

items.titleZh: 号码证书签名验证失败
items.detailsEn: This WABA has already been marked for migration to a different solution ID
items.detailsZh: 商业电话号码在注册或迁移验证时所提交的证书（cert）公钥签名与 Meta 系统注册记录不一致。
items.solutionEn: The OBO account ownership model is now [deprecated](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/solution-providers/obo-model-deprecation). Please contact support.
items.solutionZh: 在 WhatsApp Manager 重新下载最新的号码证书，确保 base64 字符串无截断或空格换行符。

items.titleZh: On-Premises 迁移凭证无效
items.detailsEn: `You have exceeded the maximum number of times to call the synchronization api for this phone number.`
items.detailsZh: 从自建 On-Premises API 迁移至 Cloud API 时所提供的备份迁移令牌已过期或权限不足。
items.solutionEn: You can only call this endpoint once to synchronize the business phone number contacts and once to synchronize its messaging history. See [Onboarding business app users](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/embedded-signup/onboarding-business-app-users#synchronizing-whatsapp-business-app-data).<br><br>Offboard the business customer and re-onboard them.
items.solutionZh: 在源 On-Premises 实例重新调用 /v1/configs/backup 获取最新的迁移凭证，并在 24 小时内完成云端导入。

items.titleZh: Cloud API 接入模式冲突
items.detailsEn: Synchronization request can only be made within 24 hours of onboarding
items.detailsZh: 号码当前已作为 On-Premises 或其他 Cloud API 商业实体运行，无法直接执行初始化注册。
items.solutionEn: You can only initiate contacts and messaging history synchronization of an onboarded WhatsApp Business app user within 24 hours of onboarding the user. See [Onboarding business app users](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/embedded-signup/onboarding-business-app-users#synchronizing-whatsapp-business-app-data).<br><br>Offboard the user and re-onboard them.
items.solutionZh: 先在源商业中心释放该号码所有权，或联系 Meta 商业技术支持协助执行号码接入模式切换。

items.titleZh: 模板入参变量不匹配或格式错误
items.detailsEn: The templateParams passed to Alibaba Cloud SendMessage API do not match the placeholders declared in the approved template.
items.detailsZh: 调用阿里云 ChatApp (国际即时通信) 接口发送 WhatsApp 消息时，传入的 templateParams 键值对或数量与阿里云审核通过的模板占位符不匹配，或变量值为空/包含了非法特殊字符。
items.solutionEn: 1. Verify template placeholders in Alibaba Cloud ChatApp Console; 2. Ensure all required parameters are provided with non-empty values; 3. Check variable character length limits.
items.solutionZh: 1. 登录阿里云控制台“全球即时通讯 (ChatApp) > 模板管理”，核对该 TemplateCode 的变量数量与顺序；2. 检查请求体 templateParams 是否有空值或未转义的双引号；3. 确保变量内容未超出 WhatsApp 字符长度限制；4. 按钮参数（如动态 URL 后缀）须使用专门的 buttonComponents 参数传入。

items.titleZh: 触发阿里云业务流控限制
items.detailsEn: Message sending rate exceeded the QPS / concurrency threshold configured on Alibaba Cloud ChatApp gateway.
items.detailsZh: 短时间内向阿里云提交的发送请求 QPS 超出了账号默认流控上限，或向单个终端手机号发送频次过于密集触发了防骚扰流控保护。
items.solutionEn: 1. Implement queue buffering (RabbitMQ/Redis) and reduce sending concurrency; 2. Apply exponential backoff before retrying; 3. Contact Alibaba Cloud support to increase QPS quota.
items.solutionZh: 1. 引入消息队列中间件（如 RocketMQ/Redis）进行异步削峰与限速调控；2. 对返回该错误的请求实施指数退避重试（Exponential Backoff）；3. 向阿里云提交工单申请调大 WhatsApp 消息发送 API 的默认 QPS 配额。

items.titleEn: WABA Account Status Restricted or Banned
items.titleZh: 底层 WABA 商业账号状态异常或已被封禁
items.detailsEn: The underlying WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) hosted through Alibaba Cloud has been restricted or banned by Meta for policy violations.
items.detailsZh: 在阿里云托管绑定的底层 WhatsApp 商业账号（WABA）因用户投诉过多、违规发送营销骚扰信息或商业认证未通过，已被 Meta 官方标记为 Restricted 或 Banned 状态，导致阿里云中继网关拒绝下发消息。
items.solutionEn: 1. Check account quality in Meta Business Suite / Account Quality; 2. Review compliance and submit an appeal if eligible; 3. Pause all mass-messaging campaigns.
items.solutionZh: 1. 登录 Meta 商务管理平台“账户品质 (Account Quality)”查看违规原因与申诉通道；2. 检查发送内容是否违反 WhatsApp Commerce & Messaging Policy；3. 立即暂停全员营销群发，保持官方会话窗口干净；4. 如符合要求可在 Meta 提交官方申诉并在阿里云工单同步进度。

items.titleZh: 阿里云国际即时通讯后台系统异常
items.detailsEn: Alibaba Cloud ChatApp internal gateway encountered an unexpected error while routing the request.
items.detailsZh: 阿里云即时通讯服务内部集群暂时性处理超时、通道网络波动或上游微服务未就绪。
items.solutionEn: 1. Retry request after a brief delay with backoff; 2. Check Alibaba Cloud health status.
items.solutionZh: 1. 等待 1~3 秒后使用相同 RequestId 或重试机制发起请求；2. 检查阿里云官网健康看板，确认国际即时通讯服务是否存在服务降级；3. 若持续发生请保存 RequestId 并提交阿里云支持工单。

items.titleEn: Sender Phone Number Not Registered in ChatApp
items.titleZh: 发信号码未在阿里云完成注册托管
items.detailsEn: The CustSpaceId or From phone number is not properly bound or verified in Alibaba Cloud WhatsApp ChatApp service.
items.detailsZh: 请求中传入的发信手机号码（From）或客户空间 ID（CustSpaceId）未在阿里云国际即时通信控制台完成两步验证绑定，或者处于离线未激活状态。
items.solutionEn: 1. Go to Alibaba Cloud ChatApp console and check phone number status; 2. Verify certificate and PIN code registration; 3. Ensure billing is active.
items.solutionZh: 1. 进入阿里云控制台“全球即时通讯 (ChatApp) > 号码管理”；2. 核对该号码的两步验证 PIN 码与证书是否已激活完成；3. 确认阿里云账号处于正常计费状态（未欠费）；4. 确保请求参数中的 From 手机号带国家代码（如 86138...）。
